about: Advisories the security job's npm gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) accepts, each by its GHSA id, until its recheck date. After that date the entry stops counting and CI fails until someone looks again (ARCHITECTURE.md §8).

entries.reason: Dev-only lint tooling run over the repository's own glob patterns; not in the production image. No fixed braces exists: every published version (latest 3.0.3) is in the advisory's range <=3.0.3, and micromatch's latest (4.0.8) requires it.
